correctness.rationale: For sequential one-pass left-to-right Rule45 on each labelled cyclic ring n>=3, checked the local Boolean identity f(a,b,c)=a xor (b or not c) and the asymmetric first/last boundary equations, which must use old x_{n-1} at i=0 and already-updated y0 at i=n-1. Interior equality marks encode exactly old 0->1 pairs, hence cannot be adjacent. Endpoint constraints recover y0 and q=y_{n-1} xor y_{n-2}. The constructive proof realizes every nonadjacent-mark word with prescribed single endpoint, giving the complete iff output language. Counting independent sets in a line gives F_n+2F_(n-1)=L_n; image entropy is log phi, not a recurrent entropy. Inspected repository check_constructive.py and separately enumerated every input and every candidate output for each n=3..13; exact reachable sets satisfy all three boundary tests and Lucas counts n=3..13 (4,7,11,18,29,47,76,123,199,322,521). Finite checks corroborate all-n constructive proof.
